$Comment: Pumpkin Fiends after dark while Hallow's Eve runs, in pumpkin country: the autumn forests of the
first zone (Env_Zone1_Autumn), where the game grows its wild pumpkins thickest. When the event
starts, the calendar writes Spawn as the game's own world-spawn rule Hallows_Eve_Fiends; when it
ends, the calendar rewrites that rule with every moon phase at zero, so nothing new spawns. A rule
is never removed. They come in small packs (Flock). Harvest_Moon_Fiend_Spawns.json names the same
Rule at a higher Priority and takes over on Harvest Moon nights.
The night, the dawn clear-out and the light gate match the Hallows_Eve_Night rule, read by the
game's own NPC/Spawn/World codec: DayTimeRange 19 to 5 is the night, Despawn clears what is still
out at dawn, and LightRanges keeps them away from anywhere a torch or a lantern lights. One rule
per creature and environment: no other rule in this pack names this role. To spread them to more
of the places pumpkins grow, add an environment here and in the Harvest Moon file together.
